description: OOS backtest of the date-aligned agent-tuned top-10 cells (by test R-Precision@3) over each cell's test_end+1 -> 2026-06-01 window, marked-to-market at data_end 2026-06-23. Champion strategy TopKDailyKellyLabelExit, selection=rank, sizing=equal, K=3, c=0.25. Ungated (no SMA200 overlay). Required two inference fixes: --allow-universe-growth and chunked predict_proba.

strategy.regime_gate: none (ungated; _017 SMA200 overlay is a separate add-on)

benchmark.note: 200d cells benched over 2024-10-04..2026-06-01 (SPX +28.4%); the H=100 cell (russell +40%/100d, test_end 2025-05-13) over its shorter 2025-05-14..2026-06-01 window (SPX +25.3%). russell1000 benched vs SPX (^RUI uncached, proxy); EW basket +29% sp500 / +19% russell1000

allow_universe_growth.cause: min_rows_per_ticker=2000 eligibility is computed over the full loaded panel [1990,end]; extending the panel to the OOS end (2026) pulls 9 recent sp500 listings (CRWD,DDOG,UBER,MRNA,CTVA,DOW,FOX,FOXA,VRT) over the 2000-row floor, so they enter the cross-section at historical test dates and re-rank rank/zscore features. Path features Delta=0; 100% of drift is cross-sectional. Build-to-test_end reproduces exactly (0.000); build-to-OOS-end diverges 0.057.
allow_universe_growth.behavior: membership change (tickers added/removed) -> warn+proceed; unchanged-membership divergence -> still abort (real _007 corruption). Default strict; /daily-predictions byte-unchanged.

chunked_predict.cause: the 3 russell xgb-agent cells were OOM-killed (exit 137) right after the feature build: full-history russell panel (~7M rows x 279 feats ~16GB X) + 143-feat Xc + XGBoost float32 predict copy exceeds the ~39GB box. CatBoost cbagents survived (lighter predict, 53-feat Xc).
chunked_predict.result: all 3 now score; self-checks PASS at 2.98e-08 -> the failures were purely a memory limit, NOT feature corruption. Output identical (predict is row-wise).

summary: 10/10 scored, 7 beat SPX. Standout russell/40-100d v14p1 +86.8% (shorter H=100 window, SPX +25.3%). russell cells dominate (4 of top 5); the 3 losses are both sp500 +40% cells + russell/50 v14p1. CatBoost-agent >= its plain XGBoost-agent sibling in 3 of 4 matchups (russell/50 the exception: agent +46.1 beats cbagent +38.2). v14p1 is high-variance (best AND worst russell). All deeper DD than SPX except the short-window H=100 cell (ungated; _017 SMA200 caps).
followups: rolling validation (_008-style) before any alpha claim (single window; the +86.8% H=100 rests on a short window)
pair with SMA200 gate (_017) for drawdown
